_comment: Agent runtime configuration — single source of CLI policy. config.py and orchestrator.md reference this file.
_routing_note: Explicit CLI/model > project role > global role > defaults; policy allowlists always apply. See standards/reference/backend-model-routing.md. No automatic retries/fallback.
_cli_note: All four support delegated role wrappers via agent_platform_mcp.backends. Gemini re-added and Copilot added 2026-10-22 (harness2-adoption); native same-AI role execution remains the default. Gemini/Copilot transcript observation is unsupported.
_host_models_note: Optional per-role pins {host: {role: model}} that override role_tiers. Routing order: explicit --model > project role > role > cli_models > host_models > claude_models > role_tiers/model_tiers > CLI default. The adapters (.claude/agents, .github/agents) resolve the same chain without the project step (scripts/sync_claude_settings.py role_models). claude_models (legacy per-role Claude map) is still honored when present; tiers replaced it on 2026-11-22.
_preferred_cli_note: preferred_cli is only a fallback for MCP wrappers that cannot ask the user directly.
_cli_models_note: Model pin per external CLI. Update here when model generations change; no code edits needed.
_model_tiers_note: Role model source for every host (2026-11-22, refactor/work-type-triage). role_tiers picks high/mid/low per role; model_tiers maps each tier to a model per backend. Claude aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku) and Gemini aliases resolve through the installed CLI version's own model table, so they move when the CLI is updated, not on their own. Gemini high/mid use `auto` (0.70.0: same as no -m, the CLI's default routing; preview access decides 3.x preview vs 2.5) and low uses `flash-lite` (0.70.0: gemini-3.1-flash-lite, or 3.5-flash-lite with latest GA access). Copilot needs exact IDs and Codex is left unset (CLI default) until `python3 scripts/models_refresh.py` proposes slugs from the local catalog (`--write --backend copilot|codex [--tier T]` applies them). An undefined tier fails sync and --check. Gate roles (planner/reviewer/security/dba) stay at least as strong as backend; qa runs real tests so it is mid, never low; cicd moved haiku->mid and investment/quant/investment-risk sonnet->high on 2026-11-22. Synced into .claude/agents (scripts/sync_claude_settings.py) and .github/agents (scripts/sync_hosts.py); do not hand-edit model lines.

risk_rules._note: Case-sensitive project-relative fnmatch patterns; leading **/ also matches root paths. Pending changes plus optional risk_base branch diff. Low + hit blocks; unavailable inspection blocks declared risk; legacy undeclared only reports.

_gate_verify_note: Legacy shell-compat command. Empty without an explicit profile means not_run (failed verification).
